title: UPSC CSE - Art & Culture - Indian Traditions, Festivals, and Calendars
subject: Art & Culture

questions.q: Which one of the following was the latest inclusion in the Intangible Cultural Heritage List of UNESCO?
questions.explain: The latest inclusion in the Intangible Cultural Heritage List of UNESCO is the Garba Dance of Gujarat in December 2023.\n\nChhau dance was included in 2010, Durga puja in 2021, and Kumbh mela in 2017.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
1. St. Francis Xavier was one of the founding members of the Jesuit Order.
2. St Francis Xavier died in Goa and a church is dedicated to him there.
3. The Feast of St. Francis Xavier is celebrated in Goa each year.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 1 is correct: St. Francis Xavier was one of the founding members of the Jesuit Order. Statement 2 is not correct: St. Francis Xavier died in 1552 in Shangchuan Island, China. Statement 3 is correct: The Feast of St. Francis Xavier is celebrated annually on December 3 in Goa.

questions.q:
Consider the following pairs:
Tradition State
1. Chapchar Kut festival Mizoram
2. Khongjom Parba Ballad Manipur
3. Thang-Ta dance Sikkim
Which of the pairs given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: Pair 1 is correctly matched: Chapchar Kut is a popular spring festival celebrated by the Mizo people of Mizoram. Pair 2 is correctly matched: Khongjom Parba ballad is a style of ballad singing from Manipur. Pair 3 is not correctly matched: Thang-Ta is a Manipuri art form, not from Sikkim.

questions.q:
Consider the following pairs:
Traditions Communities
1. Chaliha Sahib Festival Sindhis
2. Nanda Raj Jaat Yatra Gonds
3. Wari-Warkari Santhals
Which of the pairs given above is/are correctly matched?
questions.explain: Pair 1 is correctly matched: The Chaliha is an important festival celebrated by the Sindhis. Pair 2 and pair 3 are not correctly matched: Nanda Devi Raj Jaat Yatra is a festival of Gharwali and Kumaoni people in Uttarakhand. Wari Warkari or Varkari (Pandharpur Wari) is a Maharashtrian festival celebrated by Marathas.

questions.q: Every year, a month-long ecologically important campaign/festival is held during which certain communities/tribes plant saplings of fruit-bearing trees. Which of the following are such communities/tribes?
questions.explain: Every monsoon, the Gond and Korku tribes of Madhya Pradesh's Betul and Harda districts celebrate Hari Jiroti. It is a month-long festival of greenery, during which the tribals plant saplings of fruit-bearing trees.

questions.q: A community of people called Manganiyars is well-known for their
options: Classical vocal music in South India
Pietra dura tradition in Central India
questions.explain: The Manganiyars are professional Muslim folk musicians belonging to Jaisalmer, Barmer, parts of Jalor, Bikaner and Jodhpur districts in Western Rajasthan.

questions.q:
With reference to Buddhist history, tradition and culture in India, consider the following pairs:
Famous Shrine Location
1. Tabo monastery and temple complex Spiti Valley
2. Lhotsava Lhakhang temple, Nako Zanskar Valley
3. Alchi temple complex Ladakh
Which of the pairs given above is/are correctly matched?
questions.explain: Pair 1 is correctly matched: Tabo Monastery is in Spiti Valley, Himachal Pradesh. Pair 2 is not correctly matched: Lhotsava Lhakhang temple is located at Nako, Kinnaur region of Himachal Pradesh, not in Zanskar Valley. Pair 3 is correctly matched: Alchi Monastery is located in Ladakh.

questions.q: With reference to India's culture and tradition, what is 'Kalaripayattu'?
options: It is an ancient Bhakti cult of Shaivism still prevalent in some parts of South India
It is an ancient style bronze and brass work still found in southern part of Coromandel area
It is an ancient form of dance-drama and a living tradition in the northern part of Malabar
It is an ancient martial art and a living tradition in some parts of South India
questions.explain: Kalaripayattu is one of the oldest (ancient) martial art forms, practised in Kerala and parts of Tamil Nadu. It includes strikes, kicks, grappling, preset forms, weaponry and healing methods.

questions.q: Chaitra 1 of the national calendar based on the Saka Era corresponds to which one of the following dates of the Gregorian calendar in a normal year of 365 days?
questions.explain: Dates of the national calendar have a permanent correspondence with dates of the Gregorian calendar, 1st Chaitra falling on 22 March normally and on 21 March in a leap year.
